snippet.title: Pixel Pawns Match Chronicle #1 - AI level 3 vs AI level 2, 17 duels to checkmate (pixel-art chess)
snippet.description:
A full game of Pixel Pawns, the pixel-art chess game where every capture is fought out as an animated duel.
Ivory (AI level 3) plays white against Obsidian (AI level 2): 65 half-moves, 17 captures, a pawn that takes a rook and promotes, both queens traded off, a second promotion, and checkmate on move 33.

00:03 Opening and the first captures
00:41 Promotion on a8
01:00 Queens traded
01:58 The b-pawn promotes
02:11 Checkmate

Both sides are played by the game's own AI. Every move and every duel is the engine's own; the commentary reads the move log.

Pixel Pawns on the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP9G5CQKKZX?cid=yt
Website & trailer: https://pixelpawns.bugfactory.hu

AI-generated voice. Gameplay is real.
